description: The Margin eval runs a control arm (claude-code-stock) and a treatment arm (claude-code-tether). Per evals/margin/CLAUDE.md the two definitions differ ONLY in run-prepare.js, schema.json, and definition.toml; every other hook is a byte-identical copy. These two install-check.js (Margin's pre-install gate) must stay byte-identical: divergence silently makes the arms non-comparable, and there is no automatic upstream re-sync to catch it.
